name: Estun Automation
summary:
Estun Automation supplies industrial robots, automation software and integrated production solutions. Its portfolio includes general-purpose and specialized robots, collaborative robots, workstations and related equipment. The company also offers programming, simulation, vision and digital-factory tools, connecting robot hardware with the systems needed to operate an automated production process.

Applications include welding, adhesive dispensing, palletizing, polishing, press handling, bending and vision-guided picking. Its ESTUN AI offering extends this industrial base into embodied-intelligence robots and related solutions. Remote maintenance and industrial-cloud platforms support equipment monitoring and service, while training resources help customers develop and maintain robot applications.
